parsed.why: Sodomy law, no recognition or anti-discrimination protection, ~85% public hostility, vigilante violence with police impunity, unsolved mob killing of a gender-nonconforming teen, and documented identity-targeted prison violence with no working recourse.

Decriminalised 2016 with constitutional discrimination protections, 2024 harassment law naming gender identity, split-but-moderate social acceptance; remaining exposure is a latent immigration statute and unresolved border/prison practice, plus organised religious hostility without state adoption.

No criminalisation, open Pride culture, active investment in gender-neutral facilities, broad statutory protections; negatives are restroom discrimination, a rising anti-gender movement and unresolved border screening. The surgery-ID rule is resident-facing for passport-holding visitors.

Self-ID recognition, marriage equality, anti-discrimination and hate-crime law, a working trans-inmate placement protocol and LGBT-migrant protections; offset by an emblematic murder, one severe assault, institutional discrimination against a trans officer and stalled legislation.

Same-sex conduct legal and no state campaign, but common individual harassment, occasional modesty-charge misuse against gender-nonconforming people, no recognition or anti-discrimination law, unamendable opposite-sex marriage clause, and military-rule institutions offering no reliable recourse.
